title: Surge-style pass commitment with one safety correction
description: Three consecutive 5 Hz intents for one learned_policy participant on a 12 m section. The first proposes a right-side pass (commitment_raw 0.5, above the +1/3 commit threshold) and the safety layer trims the decoded lateral target from 3.68 m to 3.2 m under the passing_room constraint, a material correction by the BENCHMARKS 0.1-car-width rule. The second intent, 12 ticks later, proposes wait (commitment_raw 0.0) but the executed label stays commit_pass because the 0.4 s minimum commitment (24 ticks at 60 Hz) has not elapsed and no hazard interrupted it: the proposed decode and the executed state are recorded separately. The third intent, another 12 ticks later, releases the commitment exactly at the 0.4 s mark and executes wait again. Status 'example': the learned_policy producer kind is exercised to prove the shared contract admits it; no trained model is claimed to exist (producer_revision is a placeholder and is listed in unknowns). The 12 m section is the one the referenced observation obs.t000996.ai_surge_1 describes (12 m road width at all three lookaheads, usable half-width 6.0 m). The second and third records' source_observation_id values (obs.t001008.ai_surge_1, obs.t001020.ai_surge_1) are illustrative references to observation records that are not shipped as observation fixtures, so only the first record has a participant/tick pairing that can be verified against the observation slice; the shipped obs.t001008.ai_surge_2 belongs to a different participant and must not be read as this record's source.

lateral.note: Corridor half-width is (12.0 - 1.8)/2 - 0.5 m = 4.6 m; proposal decoded to 3.68 m, safety trimmed to 3.2 m.

pace.note: Decoding the racer desired speed-profile interval is unratified; see unknowns.

drift.note: Between the +/-0.25 drift thresholds, so the decode band is retain; the preference retained from before this window was grip.

corrections.note: 0.48 m change exceeds 0.1 car widths (0.18 m) at a 1.8 m car, so it is material per BENCHMARKS.

lateral.note: 0.75 x 4.6 m = 3.45 m, inside the corridor; no safety correction.

commitment.label: wait
commitment.note: 12 ticks (0.2 s) since the commit at tick 996, inside the 0.4 s minimum commitment and no hazard interrupted it, so the executed label stays commit_pass even though the proposed decode is wait.

lateral.note: 0.7 x 4.6 m = 3.22 m, inside the corridor; no safety correction.

commitment.label: wait
commitment.note: 24 ticks (0.4 s) since the commit at tick 996, so the minimum commitment is satisfied and the executed label follows the proposed decode back to wait.

The second and third intents' source observations are declared illustrative because the observation slice ships no such records.
